children: RLI reported third-quarter 2026 operating earnings of $0.86 per share and delivered an 86.2 combined ratio with book value up 10% year-to-date.
Operating EPS $0.86 vs. $0.82 prior year; GAAP EPS $0.88 vs. $1.35 due to equity securities mark-to-market.
Underwriting income $58.8M; combined ratio 86.2 driven by 47.4 loss ratio and 38.8 expense ratio.
Net investment income rose 13% to $46.7M; operating cash flow $195M and new fixed-income buys avg yield ~5.5%.
Segment results: Property CR 60.1 with $50M underwriting income; Casualty CR 99.6 with 4% premium growth; Surety CR 79.8 and premiums +1%.
Returned capital: quarterly dividend $0.18 and repurchased ~104k shares at $60.51; ~$232M repurchase authority remains.
